status_language: post-hoc failure analysis followed by leakage-isolated nested retrospective cross-experiment evaluation
causal_timing: All experiment-gate statistics use observations and predictions available by 12 h. The gate is applied before unit-level decisions at 12 h or later.

outer_evaluation.separation: Signal selection, orientation, normalization, and threshold use development experiments only.
outer_evaluation.rotations: leave one experiment out across all 11 experiments

unsafe_experiment_event: At least one erroneous early STOP by frozen Phase-2 full GATES at the evaluated risk target.
candidate_signal_constraints: No endpoint labels from the incoming experiment; no experiment IDs as predictors; fixed low-dimensional scalar summaries only.

gate_fitting.signal_selection: Within each outer fold, choose the single candidate signal with maximum development-experiment AUROC for the unsafe-event label. Orient values so larger means less trustworthy. Ties are resolved by the candidate order above.
gate_fitting.threshold: On development experiments only, choose the observed score cut that maximizes balanced accuracy; ties prefer fewer refused experiments and then the higher threshold.
gate_fitting.refusal_action: All units in the refused experiment continue to the 72 h full protocol and contribute zero observation savings.
gate_fitting.restrict_state: Not used because 11 experiments are insufficient to estimate two thresholds reliably.

failure_detection.unit_event: A frozen-policy early STOP whose predicted endpoint is incorrect.
failure_detection.experiment_event: at least one erroneous early STOP in the experiment
failure_detection.metric: AUROC with direction chosen on development data for nested gate use; descriptive full-sample AUROC is labelled post-hoc

confidence_intervals.group_variation: percentile bootstrap over the 11 experiments, 10000 draws, seed 20260929

interpretation: The gate was conceived after all 11 Phase-2 outcomes were observed. Outer separation limits direct outcome leakage during each fitted fold but cannot make the study prospective.
